name: AIG UK Limited

book_concentration.rationale: Deep Energy franchise including Power & Utilities and Renewables (PV solar, on/offshore wind, BESS).

non_firm_intensity.rationale: Insures utilities, merchant fleets, power producers and BESS/renewables, high interruptible/curtailable exposure.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Very large global power/utility book implies significant correlated grid exposure.

trigger_gap.rationale: UK energy page is damage/BI indemnity; group offers parametric globally but no UK-entity-specific parametric found.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Annual property/BI indemnity against long-lived power assets.

data_monitoring.rationale: Global risk-engineering and power-generation risk consulting evidenced (engineering, benchmarking, loss prevention).

product_fit.rationale: Group-level parametric/climate capability exists but not clearly an availability product for grid/data-centre at the UK entity.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Named UK Energy Renewables and UK Energy leadership teams, the deepest dedicated energy bench in the set.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: AIG UK Limited rated S&P AA- Stable, Moody's A1 Stable, AM Best A Positive.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Risk-consulting and power-generation engineering documents published but no formal pricing methodology.

notes: Among the largest power/utility insurers globally; UK book is damage/BI with parametric only at group level.

name: Antares Managing Agency (Syndicate 1274)

book_concentration.rationale: Energy is a named line within Antares' diversified Property, Casualty, Marine and Specialty book, a minority but real share.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: An energy line is written but no detail of grid-scale/curtailable power exposure is evidenced.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Diversified property/marine/specialty book across Lloyd's, Singapore and Bermuda limits single-grid concentration.

trigger_gap.rationale: No parametric or availability/non-damage product is evidenced, implying reliance on physical-damage triggers.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Energy and property covers are typically annual, broadly matched to claims experience.

data_monitoring.rationale: No energy-specific data-monitoring capability is published.

product_fit.rationale: Only conventional damage-based energy cover is implied with no parametric or availability product.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Energy is written within a broad specialty book but no named dedicated energy/power team is evidenced.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Syndicate 1274 carries A+ (S&P) and A (AM Best) via the Lloyd's chain of security, with QIC parent rated A- (AM Best).

pricing_modelling.rationale: No published energy pricing or modelling methodology is available.

notes: QIC-owned diversified Lloyd's syndicate with an energy line but no evidenced availability/parametric cover.

name: Faraday Underwriting (Syndicate 435)

book_concentration.rationale: Energy is one of roughly ten underwriting teams alongside aviation, casualty, property and agriculture, giving it a moderate-to-minor book share.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: An energy line is written but no detail of grid-scale/curtailable power exposure is evidenced, so non-firm intensity is rated low.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Ten teams underwrite a diverse range of risks worldwide, implying low single-grid concentration.

trigger_gap.rationale: No parametric or availability product is evidenced, implying reliance on physical-damage triggers.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Energy and property covers are typically annual, broadly matched to claims experience.

data_monitoring.rationale: No specific energy data-monitoring capability is published beyond general team structure.

product_fit.rationale: Only conventional damage-based energy cover is implied with no parametric or availability product.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: Faraday operates a distinct Energy underwriting team among its ten teams, indicating dedicated in-house expertise.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Syndicate 435 is S&P-rated and backed by General Re/Berkshire Hathaway, whose insurance subsidiaries hold AM Best A++ (Superior) ratings.

pricing_modelling.rationale: No published energy pricing or modelling methodology is available.

notes: Berkshire-backed syndicate with a small energy team; financially very strong but no evidenced availability/parametric product.

name: Newline Group (Syndicate 1218)

book_concentration.rationale: Newline focuses on financial lines, casualty, cargo and specialty (space/specie) with no dedicated energy/power/DC book.

non_firm_intensity.rationale: No exposure to interruptible or curtailable power-generation assets.

aggregation_correlation.rationale: Underwriting spread across more than 80 countries implies low single-grid geographic concentration.

trigger_gap.rationale: Cargo and specialty lines rely on damage triggers and no parametric/availability product is offered, though there is little energy exposure to expose.

tenor_mismatch.rationale: Casualty and specialty covers are predominantly annual with established claims history.

data_monitoring.rationale: No energy-specific data-monitoring capability is published.

product_fit.rationale: No parametric or availability/energy product is offered; the book is casualty and financial lines led.

underwriting_expertise.rationale: No dedicated energy or power underwriting team exists; expertise is in financial lines, casualty and specialty.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Syndicate 1218 carries A+ (AM Best) and AA- (S&P) ratings via the Lloyd's chain of security and Odyssey Group backing.

pricing_modelling.rationale: No published energy pricing or modelling methodology is available.

notes: Casualty/financial-lines and specialty syndicate with effectively no energy/power/DC book.
